messages.subject: Error about (getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo)
parts:
Hi NIMBLE experts,

I am trying to model two sample proportions for each county, and ultimately subtract them to get a difference in each county. However, I got an error: In dbinom(model$lb[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(INDEXEDNODEINFO_,  ... :
  NaNs produced

Could anyone please help me with this issue? Please see the code below. Thanks in advance.

Alex

tn is the total number of people in each county;
rw is the observed number of white residents in each county;
lb is the observed number of  black residents in each county;
index is the difference between rw and lb.

I.model<-nimbleCode({
 
  for (i in 1:N){
    rw[i]~dbinom(tn[i], pw[i])
   
    log(pw[i])<-betaw+v[i]
   
    lb[i]~dbinom(tn[i], pb[i])
   
    log(pb[i])<-betab+v[i]
   
    index[i]<-exp(betaw+v[i])-exp(betab+v[i])
 
  }
 
  for (i in 1:N){
    v[i]~dnorm(0, tau)
  }
   betaw~dflat()
   betab~dflat()
   tau~dgamma(1, 0.01)
   
})

messages.author: 7878556d408ec9ec
messages.subject: Re: Error about (getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo)
parts:
Hi Alex,
I think this seems to be because you used log instead of logit for the probabilities of binomial distributions in the model code. Try the latter and see what happens. 

-Wei
